surface_verification.runner: uv run --directory plugins/shipwright-security --extra dev pytest tests/ -v

behaviors.behavior: One coverage row per weakness class, closed status vocabulary
Status precedence degraded > not_requested > not_available > covered
A backend capability outside the OSS tool map still gets a row
Prompt-injection row added only when it carries information
An empty or absent manifest is never 'complete'
findings.json carries coverage; the --input-from-cache re-read keeps it
Report renders the coverage banner and table, PR mode included
'Coverage not reported' stays distinct from 'Incomplete Coverage'
Sidecar gains coverage while schema_version stays 1
The local gitleaks config extends the project's own .gitleaks.toml
extend.useDefault and extend.path are never both emitted
The extend path is absolute even when the scanned target is relative
Full TOML basic-string escaping of the extend path
A rule-less project gitleaks config is named, not silently obeyed
The real gitleaks binary honours the extend: default rules still fire, the project allowlist applies, the shipwright exclusions survive
behaviors.evidence: test_gitleaks_extend_smoke.py (2) — real-binary test. Executes in CI, where .github/workflows/ci.yml installs gitleaks 8.21.2, and HARD-FAILS there if the binary is absent (skip_or_fail_on_missing_binary). SKIPPED on this machine: no scanner binary is installed here, which is the exact condition AC-1 exists to surface.

behaviors.behavior: Comparison computes resolved/new/persisting only over classes both runs covered
Losing or gaining a tool between runs claims nothing fixed or new
No stored per-finding outcome; compare_scans does not mutate its inputs
Unclassifiable findings are counted, never resolved, and surfaced in the render
Location-based fingerprint: a moved finding reads as resolved+new
compare_scans.py CLI renders a comparison and exits 2 with no prior scan
The card carries per-severity counts and asks how far to go
Scope options are concrete, ordered most-severe-first, and never a fake tier
The card names unchecked classes; a degraded leg never reads as all-clear
Caller-supplied repo/report_path cannot open a new instruction line in the payload
The card carries no raw finding strings (inbox hygiene)
One card per repo; it coexists with the per-finding enumeration
degraded is derived from what happened to the leg, not the exit code alone
Pre-feature artifacts (no coverage key) are tolerated by every named reader
No baselined file exceeds its recorded bloat `current`
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/hooks/anti_ratchet_check.py --worktree exits 0; the four shrunk files' baselines were re-synced to their final measured sizes

behaviors.behavior: The SKILL.md Step 2.5 scope gate is actually followed at the point of work
behaviors.reason: A prompt-level instruction to the executing agent plus an AskUserQuestion round-trip with a human. The machine-checkable half — the card telling it to ask, with the counts — is covered by the card behaviors above.
